Get a monitor run
Copy page

Gets a specific monitor run.

GET
/
v0
/
monitors
/
{monitor}
/
runs
/
{id}
Try it
Authorizations
apiKey
bearer
apiKey
​
x-api-key
stringheaderrequired

Pass your Exa API key in the x-api-key header. You can also authenticate with Authorization: Bearer .

Path Parameters
​
monitor
stringrequired

The id of the Monitor to get the run for

​
id
stringrequired
Response
200 - application/json

Monitor run details

​
id
stringrequired

The unique identifier for the Monitor Run

​
object
enum<string>required

The type of object

Available options: monitor_run 
​
monitorId
stringrequired

The monitor that the run is associated with

​
status
enum<string>required

The status of the Monitor Run

Available options: created, running, completed, canceled, failed 
​
completedAt
string<date-time> | nullrequired

When the run completed

​
failedAt
string<date-time> | nullrequired

When the run failed

​
failedReason
string | nullrequired

The reason the run failed

​
canceledAt
string<date-time> | nullrequired

When the run was canceled

​
createdAt
string<date-time>required

When the run was created

​
updatedAt
string<date-time>required

When the run was last updated

​
type
enum<string>required

The type of the Monitor Run

Available options: search, refresh
